text: Whoa, why is my arm all bumpy?
There's a tiny muscle at the root of each hair, and it just clenches up to do this.
Back when we were covered in fur, this trick kept us warm or made us look bigger to threats. We barely have fur left, but the reflex never got the memo.
Ever see a scared cat with its fur puffed all the way out? A hedgehog bristling its quills works the exact same way.
That's why English calls it goosebumps - it looks like plucked goose skin - and Korean calls the exact same thing "chicken skin."
